title: Associate Degrees in Hand, 'Not the Right Skill Match,' & Launching Prairie Twin Interactive From Arvin Road
description: Back home in Virginia Beach after their birthday week in Alexandria, Katie and Nate apply for traditional web-development jobs with their CCHR associate degrees and PHP/SQL skills—only for employers to carefully reject them with legally safe 'not the right skill match' excuses once they roll in with power wheelchairs, inspiring the twins to launch their own paid client web studio under their Virginia LLC from their dual-desk home office.
